note: Targets are the predeclared WORKLOAD.md targets. No status from a harness summary is treated as proof of measured success.

visibility.note: Observation latency is an upper bound; probes impose measured read traffic and may observe storage before acknowledgment.

reconciliation.note: Stored masks derive from bounded FINAL identity queries; classifications are checked against raw export records. Physical duplicate counts cannot be inferred from masks.

resources.note: Docker CPU100% is one core; quota-normalized maxima use inspected limits. Memory is Docker's reported usage/cache convention. Block I/O is cumulative traffic, not disk occupancy; reset counters produce null deltas. Means are unweighted sample means.

storage.note: Global retained-corpus physical rows/parts/bytes include background merges and other retained runs; they are not unique identity reconciliation.
